sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for New York Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade computer vision built specifically for New York's dense urban, financial, and retail environment.

items.title: Retail Analytics and Loss Prevention
items.description: New York's retail density — Manhattan's vertically-stacked retail, Brooklyn's diverse neighborhood retail, and the metro area's enormous suburban mall and big-box footprint — creates significant computer vision opportunity. Loss prevention AI: real-time detection of shoplifting behavior, concealment actions, and self-checkout fraud from existing security camera infrastructure — reducing $1.5–$3.5% retail shrink rates. Customer behavior analytics: foot traffic counting, zone dwell time analysis, and customer journey mapping through store layouts — enabling data-driven store design optimization. Planogram compliance monitoring: automated detection of out-of-stock, misplaced products, and planogram deviations. Queue and wait time management: computer vision monitoring checkout and service queue lengths, triggering staff dispatch when wait times exceed thresholds. Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Retail Analytics

items.title: Financial Document Intelligence (OCR and Extraction)
items.description: New York's financial sector — investment banks, commercial banks, insurance companies, asset managers — processes enormous volumes of financial documents that computer vision and OCR intelligence can automate. Financial statement extraction: balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow data extracted from PDF financial statements and annual reports. Trade confirmation processing: visual extraction from trade confirmation documents in varied formats. Insurance document processing: policy documents, endorsements, and claims forms in varied formats. Real estate document intelligence: lease abstracts, property surveys, and title documents processed for New York's commercial real estate market. Cost: $35,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Document Intelligence

items.title: Security and Safety AI for New York Environments
items.description: New York's urban density and building stock create specific security vision use cases. Building access analytics: tailgating detection, occupancy monitoring, and unauthorized access detection for New York's commercial office buildings. Construction site safety: PPE compliance monitoring, worker proximity to hazardous equipment, and hard hat/reflective vest detection for New York's constant construction activity. Incident detection: slip and fall detection, smoke and fire early detection, and crowd density monitoring for New York's high-traffic public and commercial spaces. Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Security & Safety

items.title: Healthcare Medical Imaging AI

ClickMasters builds computer vision for radiology AI, pathology image analysis, and dermatology imaging applications with FDA SaMD awareness and HIPAA-compliant data handling. Cost: $80,000–$220,000 | Timeline: 16–32 weeks | FDA SaMD + HIPAA.
